 WHEREAS 
 
 The Developer is developing a real estate project named and styled as ‘ Zameen Ace Mall ’ , co mprising commercial shops, hotel apartments and residential apartments , located at Plot No. 36A, Sector J, Jinnah Avenue/Sir Syed Boulevard, Phase II, DHA Islamabad (“ Project ”); 
 
 The Buyer has seen the plan for the Project and the F loor P lan of the Project and desires to purchase the commercial shop as described in Description of Purchased Unit (“ Purchased Unit ”); and 
 
 The Developer has agreed to construct and sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer on the terms and conditions of this Agreement to Sell . 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, t he Parties agree as follows , intending to be legally bound, agree to the following terms and conditions: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 For the consideration provided in this Agreement (defined below), including without limitation the Purchase Price, the Developer will construct and sell rights in the Purchased Unit to the Buyer in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement along with all documents attached hereto, as may be amended from time to time. Provided that where there is more than one person or entity as the “ Buyer ”, then the obligations of the persons or entities in relation hereto shall be joint and several. 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the sale and purchase of the Purchased Unit, all of which shall form an integral part of the Agreement ( the “Agreement” ) . 
 Description of Purchased Unit 
 This Agreement to Sell 
 General Terms and Conditions 
 Nominees 
 Undertaking by the Buyer for compliance with occupancy rules. 
 Attachment A : Payment Plan 
 Attachment B : Purchased Unit Floor Plan 
 Any other document forming part of the Agreement pursuant to the terms and conditions thereof . 
 
 The documents enumerated in Clause 2 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions , followed by the Payment Plan , and Description of Purchased Unit . Any terms used as defined terms shall have the meaning assigned to them in the General Terms and Conditions. The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Agreement. 
 
 BUYER ’S WARRANTIES 
 The Buyer confirms having read and understood , and agrees to comply with this Agreement and by any further terms and conditions as may be prescribed from time to time by t he Developer . 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that all details provided by the Buyer in this Agreement are true and correct in all respects. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and warrants that the Buyer (and where there is more than one Buyer , each such Buyer ) has the requisite capacity and authority to enter into the Agreement and to perform the obligations hereunder. 
 
 ARBITRATION 
 Any dispute or difference as to the Agreement or any part thereof or any matter or thing of whatsoever nature arising thereunder or in relation thereto between t he Developer and the Buyer that cannot be resolved through mutual agreement may be referred to arbitration in accordance with the General Terms and Conditions.

 AGREEMENT TO SELL 
 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 Unless inconsistent with the context, the following words will have the meanings assigned below: 
 
 Agreement means the Agreement to sell, including these General Terms and Conditions as well as all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to sell, as may be amended or supplemented by the Developer from time to time at its sole discretion. 
 
 Agreement to Sell means the Agreement to Sell entered into between the Developer and the Buyer to which these General Terms and Conditions are appended. 
 
 Adjusted Amount has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3.3 of these General T erms and C onditions. 
 
 Adjusted Amount Instalments has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 3.4. 
 
 Buyer means the person or persons identified as the Buyer in the Agreement to Sell and his/her or their respective heirs, executors, administrators, successors, permitted transferees and permitted assigns. Where there is more than one Buyer, references to one Buyer shall be to such persons jointly and severally. 
 
 Common Areas means those parts of the Project not physically forming a part of any Unit and are intended for the common use of all occupants or owners of Units , including inter alia all open areas, elevators, administrative office areas, security system, lobbies and hallways . 
 
 Common Facilities means all roads, pavements, water features, installations, elevators, power backup equipment, security system, tube-well motors, improvements and common assets of the Common Areas that are intended for facilitating all occupants and owners of Units and do not form part of any given U nit . 
 
 Competent Authority means any federal, provincial , capital or local government or authority, department, local, regulatory, statutory or housing authority, which has jurisdiction over any aspect or part of the Project or the Agreement. 
 
 Completion or Estimated C ompletion D ate 
 means the date or expected date communicated by the Developer as the date or expected date on which the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer, subject to the Buyer complying with his/her obligations inter alia as per Clause 4 (Construction and Possession of Purchased Unit) of these General T erms and C onditions. 
 
 Completion Notice means a written notice sent to the Buyer by the Developer communicating the Completion Date. 
 
 Component Materials means inter alia steel, cement, diesel, petroleum, oil and/or lubricants labour or any other material used for construction and finishing of the Project . 
 
 Developer means ZUI Investments . 
 
 Down Payment means the amount paid by the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell , equal to 30% (thirty percent) of the Purchas e Price (defined below) of the Purchased Unit , as shown in the Payment Plan . 
 
 Due Date means the date on or before which any payment or instalment in the Payment Plan is required to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer in the designated bank account. 
 
 Event of Force Majeure has the meaning assigned to it in Clause 13.1 of these General T erms and C onditions. 
 
 Instalment Payment means any payment to be made by the Buyer as per the Payment Plan (defined below). For the avoidance of doubt, Instalment Payment may , subject to Clause 3.3, include the any applicable Adjusted Amount. 
 
 Management Company means the entity or entities , which may include the Developer, any of its affiliates or associated companies or any other company (and their respective successors in interest and assigns) charged with the maintenance, operation or management of the Project or any part thereof, including inter alia Parking Area, Common Areas and/or Common Facilities. 
 
 Nominee means such person , as may be nominated by the Buyer as the person who may facilitate in the transfer of rights and obligations of the Buyer under the Agreement to Sell to the legal heirs in the event of demise of the Buyer . 
 
 Parking Area means the demarcated parking area for the exclusive use of visitors and occupants of the Project , the exact position whereof is to be allocated on or before the Completion Date . 
 
 Party means the Developer or the Buyer, whereas Parties means both. 
 
 Payment Plan means the Payment Plan in Attachment A of the Agreement to Sell , setting out the Due Date, qua ntum and schedule of Installment Payments of the Purchase Price to be paid by the Buyer to the Developer . 
 
 Permitted Use means the permissible nature and use of the Purchased Unit as a commercial shop strictly in accordance with the Rules (defined below) . 
 
 Project means the real estate project , named and styled as ‘ Zameen Ace Mall ’ , approved by Defence Housing Authority Islamabad, Rawalpindi, being constructed and developed by the Developer on Plot No. 36A, Sector J, Jinnah Avenue/Sir Syed Boulevard, DHA, Islamabad. 
 
 Purchase Price means the total amount identified i n the Payment Plan in Attachment A of the Agreement to Sell as the p urchase price of the Purchased Unit payable by the Buyer in accordance with the Payment Plan, together with any Adjusted Amount which may be payable under Clause 3.3 . 
 
 Purchased Unit means the specific commercial shop, as shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan , which the Buyer has contracted to purchase pursuant to th is Agreement . 
 
 Purchased Unit Floor Plan means the floor plan of the Purchased Unit and its location as shown in Attachment B to the Agreement to Sell. 
 
 Rules means such rules, as amended from time to time, as may be framed by t he Developer and/or the Management Company setting out the Buyer’s rights and obligations in relation to the use, occupancy, layout, maintenance, design and display of the Purchased Unit. 
 
 Service Charges Advance means the amount payable by the Buyer to the Management Company in advance on account of Service Charge , to be paid at the time of possession of the Purchased Unit, or as otherwise stipulated in these General Terms and Conditions . 
 
 Service Charges means the amount payable by the Buyer to the Management Company on a bi-annual basis in advance as the proportionate contribution towards the management, administration, maintenance and control of the Purchased Unit, Common Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Area, which amount shall be determined and prescribed from time to time by the Management Company provided that Service Charges shall always be reasonable, based on market standards and as per fair market rates . The first such Service Charge will be payable as Service Charges Advance . 
 
 Taxes means any federal, provincial or local taxes or levies payable on any component used for the construction of the Purchased Unit (including the Component Materials) or, where the context permits, applicable on the sale or lease thereof . 
 
 Unit means any one or more of residential apartment, hotel apartment, commercial shop or other type of unit in the Project, including the Purchased Unit. 
 
 
 Except where the context otherwise requires, references in the Agreement to: 
 
 An Article, Clause, attachment , or paragraph are references to an Article, Clause, attachment or paragraph of the Agreement or the relevant document comprising the Agreement; 
 
 Any headings in the A greement are for ease of reference only and are not to be taken into account in construction or interpretation; 
 
 Any statute or other legislative provision shall be read to include any statutory or legislative modification, amendment or re-enactment thereof; 
 
 Words denoting one gender shall include all other genders; 
 
 Words denoting singular shall, where the context permits, include plural; 
 
 Any reference to a date or time is to such date and time in Islamabad , Pakistan; 
 
 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of the Agreement or any part of the Agreement; 
 
 Use of the terms “including”, “include” or “includes” shall be interpreted to be followed by the phrase “without limitation”, unless otherwise specified; 
 
 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing include an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction. 
 
 “law” includes any law, by-law, regulation (including any rule, official directive, request or guideline), legislation (including delegated legislation), constitution, decree, judgment, court order/authority of competent jurisdiction, ordinance, statute, treaty or other legislative measure of any governmental body or any Competent Authority; 
 
 Where there is a reference to “sell”, “sale” or other transfer of rights in any U nit by t he Developer to the Buyer, such term refers to a sale of t he Developer ’s rights relating to the Purchased Unit concerned, including the right to occupy and use such Unit and, where applicable, transfer those rights all upon and subject to the General Terms and Conditions. 
 
 SALE OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 The Developer confirms that it has the necessary rights and title to the Project , to construct the Project and to sell the Purchased Unit and that it has received requisite approvals from Competent Authorities for the development and construction of the Project . Further, t he Developer agrees to construct the Project and sell the Purchased Unit to the Buyer, and the Buyer agrees to purchase the Purchased Unit from t he Developer , strictly in accordance with the Agreement and the terms and conditions thereof. 
 
 
 
 PA YMENT 
 
 The consideration for construction and transfer of possession of the Purchased Unit by t he Developer shall be subject to the following: 
 
 Payment of each Instalment Payment by the Buyer on or before the relevant Due Date and along with any applicable Adjusted Amount such as to constitute the entire Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit , as more fully described in the Payment Plan Attachment A of the Agreement ; 
 
 Payment of one time Service Charges Advance by the Buyer at the time of possession of the Purchased Unit , unless otherwise specified, to be determined as per fair market rates ; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all , electricity, water , or other utility and meter connection charges , as per applicable laws, as and when due ; 
 
 Payment by the Buyer of all applicable (if any) allotment, transfer, sub-lease, land registration, membership and other fees, stamp duties, levies, taxes , CVT or any other charges whatsoever for registration or transfer of the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer; 
 
 In the event that the Buyer chooses to have his/her rights recorded in the relevant land registry , then c ompletion of any and all formalities by the Buyer in relation thereto; and 
 
 The Buyer ’s formal written undertaking to abide by all Rules and all other rules or regulations prescribed by any Competent Authority as may be applicable on the Purchased Unit , and to make all payments of duties, taxes, levies and charges whatsoever as may be applicable on the Purchased Unit or the Buyer’s ownership thereof or other rights therein. 
 
 Both the Parties agree that the “Purchase Price” does not include any costs associated with the recording of any rights in the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer, including the registration and stamping of the sale /purchase documentation or any other fee or charge (if any) as envisaged under clause 3. 1 ( i v) which shall be payable separately by the Buyer. 
 
 The Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit shall remain fixed under this Agreement. However, the Purchase Price may be adjusted if, between the date of signing of this Agreement and the Completion date, there is an increase in the price of Component Material, as per the price indices published by the Pakistan Bureau of Statistics insofar as applicable, or if there is an increase in applicable Taxes or any new Taxes. In this event, the Developer will make every possible effort for the Purchase Price to remain and ensure that the remaining Purchase Price is adjusted in a fair and reasonable manner In the event of a forex fluctuation, s o that the Pakistani Rupee devalues against the US Dollar to at least PKR 145 to US$1, and/or any increase in applicable taxes resulting in an increase in the cost of construction and finishing of the Purchased Unit, then the Purchase Price shall be adjusted in a fair and reasonable manner (the “ Adjusted Amount ”). 
 
 The adjustment in t he Purchase Price under Clause 3.3 shall be to the extent of increase in the price of Component Material and Taxes only for the remaining construction or finishing of the Purchased Unit , and the Buyer undertakes to pay the Adjusted Amount , which shall be deemed a part of the Payment Plan and the Purchase Price, payable by the Buyer at the time of possession upon completion of the Purchased Unit Project, either piecemeal or in one lump sum , which shall be deemed a part of the Payment Plan (the “ Adjusted Amount Instalments ”) . 
 
 The Buyer shall pay each Instalment Payment and/ or Adjusted Amount Instalments on its Du e Date or within thirty (30) days thereof , without any deduction on account of bank charges, bank transfer charges , conversion cost, exchange rate fluctuations or otherwise howsoever , all of which shall be borne by the Buyer . Such payment shall be affected effected by one of the following means to be adjusted in the Developer’s account on or before the Due Date , and the Buyer understands that failure to do so will be a breach of the Agreement, entitling t he Developer to take such action as specified in Clause 12.1. 
 
 By crossed cheque or bank draft in favour of “ Zameen Ace Mall (DHA Approved) ” ;

 CONSTRUCTION AND POSSESSION OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 It is agreed and understood by the Buyer that the Estimated Completion Date represents the date by which it is presently expected that the Project will be completed, and the Purchased Unit will be ready for handover to the Buyer , whereas the Completion Date represents the date by which the Project is completed and the Purchased Unit is ready for handover to the Buyer . 
 
 The Developer shall issue the Co mpletion Notice to the Buyer communicating the proposed Completion Date. The Completion Date shall be the date on which t he Purchased Unit shall be ready for handover of possession to the Buyer , provided that the Buyer has fulfilled its obligations under this Agreement and paid all I nstalment Payments and any applicable Adjusted Amount under the Payment Plan . The Completion Date may be earlier or later than the Estimated Completion Date, in which case the Developer shall give one (1) month’s advance notice to the Buyer. In the event that the Completion Date is earlier than the Estimated Completion Date, the Buyer may postpone possession up to ( but no later than) the Estimated Completion Date. The I nstalment Payment and Adjusted Amount due on possession, as indicated in the Payment Plan , shall , under this Clause 4.2, only be payable by the Buyer at the time of possession. Transfer of possession shall be subject to the Buyer having fully performed his/her obligations under the Agreement and clearing all required payment(s), charges and taxes under provision s of the Agreement , including the Buyer having completed all applicable transfer formalities, including payment of all fees, charges and stamp duty etc., and , where applicable, recording of the Buyer ’s rights in the Purchased Unit with any relevant Competent Authority. 
 
 All risks, responsibilities and obligations associated with the Purchased Unit shall pass to the Buyer as and from the Completion Date, whereas rights in the Purchased Unit shall be transferred with actual possession thereof in accordance with the Terms and Conditions of the Agreement. 
 
 The Buyer shall pay, as and when due and without delay , all costs and charges for electricity, water and meter connections charges , and failure to do so will be a default under this Agreement. The Developer shall make every reasonable effort to obtain permanent electricity, water and meter connections for the Purchased Unit and meters in respect thereof on or before the Completion Date , subject to the Buyer having fulfilled all of his/her obligations hereunder. 
 
 Subject to Clause 4.2 above, the Buyer shall take actual possession of the Purchased Unit within thirty (30) days of the Completion Date after clearance of any outstanding dues and payments and execution of any relevant undertakings and agreements by the Buyer . In the event the Buyer fails to make the relevant payments and provide undertakings as required under Clause 3.1 or oth erwise to take possession of the Purchased Unit within said thirty (30) days of the Completion Date , subject to Clause 4.2 , the Buyer shall inter alia be responsible for s uch additional charge(s) as t he Developer deems fit to cover its administration and service costs , and the Buyer shall be liable for all risk and costs applicable to the Purchased Unit as and from the Completion Date (including loss of or damage to the Purchased Unit or any part thereof). 
 
 TAXES 
 
 The Buyer shall pay all taxes pertaining to possession, registration, stamp duties , transfer fees, CVT, assessments, or related fees, costs, duties and charges as may be required to affect the transfer and issue of title documents in favour of the Buyer , as well as related to utilities and other charges with respect to the Purchased Unit. To the extent any payment of any such taxes, transfer fees, rates, assessments, utilities or other charges, are paid by t he Developer on behalf of the Buye r (at the Developer’s discretion) , the same shall be reimbursed by the Buyer prior to handover of possession of the Purchased Unit . The Buyer shall also be responsible for all taxes, duties and charges on the transfer or assignment of any rights of the Buyer under the Agreement or in the Purchased Unit. 
 
 The Buyer agrees to pay all taxes and assessments in respect of the Purchased Unit from the Completion Date. In the event that utilities are provided to the Buyer directly by the Management Company, such amounts will be in addition to the Services Charges or Services Charges Advance and the Buyer shall settle any such charges as per consumption or usage promptly when required to do so. 
 
 TRANSFER OF PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 On the Completion Date, subject to Clause 4 , the Developer shall transfer vacant possession of the Purchased Unit to the Buyer a nd provide the allotment letter issued by Defence Housing Authority Islamabad, Rawalpindi, in favour of the Buyer, provided the Buyer has fulfilled its obligations under this Agreement (including without limitation each Instal ment Payment and payment of any applicable Adjusted Amount Instalment ) and other costs identified in the Agreement , or otherwise applicable. The Developer shall render all reasonable assistance to the Buyer , including issuance of NOC , for recording of Buyer’s rights in the relevant land registry . The Developer shall not be obliged to hand over possession of the Purchased Unit where the Buyer is not in compliance with its obligations under the Agreement. For the avoidance of doubt, recording of Buyer’s rights in the relevant land registry shall be at the discretion and cost of the Buyer. 
 
 In the event that the Buyer sells the Purchased Unit to any other person (the “Third Party”) in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement , the sale and transfer of the Purchased Unit to such Third Party shall be subject to issuance of NOC by the Developer, upon obtaining which title in the Purchased Unit may be transferred from the Buyer to the Third Party in the relevant land registry (if required ) , costs whereof will be in addition to any applicable transfer charges. The Buyer undertakes that such Third Party shall be bound by the terms and conditions of this Agreement, as and when applicable. 
 
 The Buyer will execute all documents and obtain all permissions, NOCs and/or approvals as may be required by t he Developer from time to time . 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that only the title of the Purchased Unit shall be transferred to the Buyer, and the Buyer shall have no title, right or interest in the Project other than the limited rights of access to C ommon Areas, Common Facilities and Parking Area as expressly provided herein. The Buyer understands and acknowledges that the ownership rights to the Common Areas, Common Facilities, Parking Area, roof and exterior walls shall always rest with the Developer, and the Buyer shall not be permitted to affect any change in the colour scheme , design and/or layout in relation thereto, including any projections, hooks or nails, etc. 
 
 DEVELOPER ’S COVENANTS AND WARRANTIES 
 
 The Developer covenants or warrants as under: 
 
 The Developer covenants to carry out construction of the Project in compliance and to be built substantially in accordance with good building and engineering practice s , using suitable materials and in accordance with the requirements of concerned authorities , building codes, laws, rules and regulations currently in force. 
 
 The Developer shall obtain and , to the extent possible , assign to the Buyer the benefit of any manufacturer s ’ warranties, in respect of any fixtures or fittings installed by or on behalf of t he Developer in the Purchased Unit. The Developer makes no independent representation or warranty as regards the fitness for use or quality of appliances, fittings or fixtures and h as relied on the manufacturers’/ suppliers ’ representations and warranties in this regard. 
 
 In case t he Purchased Unit requires any structural repairs or structural rectification, other than regular wear and tear , the Developer shal l rectify or repair the same for a period of five ( 5 ) year s from the Completion Date . 
 
 The Purchased Unit is subject to a builder’s defects liability warranty in respect of any defective material, fittings and fixtures including mechanical, plumbing and electrical works for a period of one (1) year from the date of completion of the construction thereof, except where such defects arise from an Event of Force Majeure or are caused or contributed to by the Buyer in the sole opinion of t he Developer . 
 
 The Developer , through the building contractor, shall remain liable for a period of one (1) year from the Completion Date to repair or replace any inherently defective material, fittings and fixtures which shall include civil, mechanical, plumbing , and electrical works provided that the maintenance and/or replacement of all appliances in the Purchased Unit shall be covered by the warranties of respective manufacturers and t he Developer shall have no liability thereof. 
 
 For avoidance of any doubt it is clarified that the period of structural liability ( Clause 7.3 ), defects liability warranty ( Clause 7.4 ) and appliances and equipment warranties ( Clause 7.5 ), shall start with effect from the Completion Date. 
 
 The Developer will not be liable for any damage caused to the structure, fittings and fixtures where the damage is caused by normal wear and tear or where there is breakage or accidental damage caused or contributed to by any act or omission of the Buye r, occupant or visitor of the Purchased Unit. 
 
 The Developer shall deliver the Purchased Unit to the Buyer in a professionally finished condition, clean and ready for occupation and constructed subject to the terms of the Agreement. 
 
 The Developer shall construct or cause the construction of the infrastructure relating to the Project including roads, lighting, walkways, and landscaping substantively in accordance with its overall development plan for infrastructure of the Project. 
 
 The Developer will arrange for the Common Facilities to be managed in a professional manner through the Management Company.

 The Buyer warrants that the Purchased Unit is being purchased on the Buyer’s own behalf and the ownership interest will be beneficially owned by the Buyer and the Buyer has the necessary legal capacity and authority to purchase the same. 
 
 The Buyer warrants that the Purchased Unit will be used only for the Permitted Use.

 not use the Purchased Unit for any illegal , unlawful or immoral act or purpose and shall not store inflammable or hazardous material or any material forbidden by l aw in the Purchased Unit;

 pay all charges (including meter connection charges relating to the Purchased Unit) for water, electricity, sewage, telephone/cables and other services provided to the Purchased Unit, maintenance fees and other similar levies that may be imposed or levied with respect to the Purchased Unit from the Completion Date; 
 
 not make any partitions, alterations, additions, attachments of any nature in the Purchased Unit , Common Areas or Facilities or to the Project without t he Developer ’s written consent in advance, and that the Buyer will pay such administration charges to t he Developer as may be demanded for vetting plans in respect of such partitions, altera tions, attachments or additions; 
 
 understand s and acknowledges that his / their obligations in the Agreement shall cont inue beyond the Completion Date; 
 
 undertakes to maintain any insurance over the Purchased Unit as may be prescribed in the Rules;

 the aesthetic view of the Purchased Unit is not altered /changed permanently , and shall maintain the structure of the Purchased Unit in such a state of repair and condition as shall , at all time s, provide structural support, protection and de sign to the Project , and not harm or da mage the Project in any manner ; and 
 
 not use the Purchased Unit or Project or any part there of for any commercial activity of any kind at any time other than in accordance with the Permitted Use . In case of breach, t he Developer or the Management Company may apply reasonable force to shut down such activity and take legal action to prevent or halt such activity or take any other action in accordance with the Rules and applicable laws . 
 
 The Buyer shall be liable for any damage caused to the structure, material, fittings and fixtures including inter alia mechanical, plumbing and electrical works, where the damage is caused by normal wear and tear , an Event of Force Majeure or where there is breakage or accidental damage caused or contributed to by any act or omission of the Buyer, occupant or visitor of the Purchased Unit. 
 
 The Buyer shall pay Service Charges to the Management Company in a timely manner , which shall be payable even if the Purchased Unit is lying vacant . All other regulations imposed by the Management Company or any association of owners or a Competent Authority in the present and in future will form a part of the Agreement. In addition to the Service Charges, it is understood by the Buyer that various Common Facilities and Common Areas, including inter alia elevators, power backup e quipment, security system, tube- well motors, may require major repair or replacement, which shall be charged to residents or occupants of the Project at actual cost and as per fair and reasonable market rates, and shall be required to be paid within the time stipulated by t he Management Company . 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges, understands and accepts that the Developer shall have the sole authority and discretion to frame the Rules, including inter alia the absolute authority to make or cause to be made any structural changes in the Purchased Unit so as to combine the Purchased Unit with any other commercial Unit in the Project if required only in the event of lease of a combination of commercial Units to a single lessee, as well as to determine rates of rent at fair market value which shall be disbursed to the Buyer on a pro-rated basis per square foot of the Purchased Unit. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and understands that t he Developer shall construct the infrastructure relating to the Project including boundary walls, roads, lighting, walkways , lobbies, hallways and landscaping substantively in accordance with t he Developer ’s overall development plan for infrastructure and the Buyer shall have no objection to it. 
 
 The Buyer agrees not to modify, add or remove any part of the exterior and/ or interior of the Purchased Unit or construct any additional improvements in the Purchased Unit without the prior written consent of t he Developer . 
 
 The Developer shall endeavour and make all reasonable efforts to deliver the Purchased Unit as per the specifications Description of Purchased Unit . However, in the event of any modification, the Developer may substitute the Purchased Unit but with another unit with similar specifications as the Purchased Unit. In the event the alternate Purchased Unit provided to the Buyer is of a lesser value the Buyer will be entitled to a refund of the difference between the Purchase Price of the original Purchased Unit and the alternate Unit without an y mark up or adjustment thereon, subject to the terms of the Agreement. 
 
 The Buyer confirms and declares that all the statements made and information provided by the Buyer in the Agreement are true and correct. In case any such statement or information is found to be incorrect or false , t he Developer shall have the right to cancel/terminate the allocation of the Purchased Unit to the Buyer by notice in writing, and any amount paid by the Buyer to t he Developer will be forfeited in the manner and in terms of Clause 12 below . 
 
 SALE AND ASSIGNMENT BY THE BUYER 
 
 No sale, assignment, transfer or other disposition of an interest in the Purchased Unit , whether before or after the Completion Date , will be binding on t he Developer or of any legal effect until and unless: 
 
 t he Developer ’s prior written consent to such transfer has been obtained by the Buyer; 
 
 the fees payable under Clause 9.2 or otherwise howsoever have been paid in full to the satisfaction of t he Developer ; 
 
 all relevant taxes, duties , and charges (including stamp duties and registration charges) have been paid upon transfer; 
 
 all payments due as at the effective date of the proposed transfer have been paid in full to the Developer and any Competent Authorities to their satisfaction; and 
 
 the transferee to the Purchased Unit has agreed and undertaken in writing to be bound by the Agreement and has signed a letter of adherence or such other document as may be prescribed by t he Developer in this regard. 
 
 Any assignment, transfer or sale of the Purchased Unit by the Buyer shall be subject to payment of transfer charges of one percent ( 1 %) of the Purchase Price of the Purchased Unit, and any other applicable fees at the time, to the Developer . While allowing the assignment or sale, t he Developer shall have the right to impose additional terms and conditions. 
 
 The Developer may assign or otherwise transfer its rights and obligations under the Agreement or with respect to the Project to any person or party by giving written notice to the Buyer and the Buyer hereby consents to any such assignment or transfer. However, t he Developer shall take reasonable steps to ensure that the interests of the Buyer unde r the Agreement are protected. 
 
 MODIFICATIONS TO THE PURCHASED UNIT 
 
 The Developer will endeavour and make all reasonable efforts to deliver the Project and Purchased Unit as per this Agreement. However, the construction of the Project and the Purchased Unit may be affected according to the plans/specifications approved by the Competent Authorities. Similar quality will be provided for any substituted items pertaining to the Purchased Unit Floor Plan, colours, materials, finishes, equipment, fixtures and specifications of the Purchased Unit . The Buyer shall be consulted in the event that any material change varies by more than 10% (ten percent). 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that f or the purposes of the Agreement , the total area is measured from the exterior face of the exterior wall, middle of the unit demising walls and exterior face of the corridor walls and includes all projections or protrusions . If the actual total area as determined by t he Developer ’s engineer is more or less than the represented total area by more than two percent ( 2%), the Purchase Price will be adjusted by an amount equal to the variance above two percent (2%). For the avoidance of doubt, n o adjustment will be made to the Purchase Price if the total area is increased or is reduced by less than two percent (2%). Provided that any change or alteration in the size and structure of the Project shall not exceed more than 10 %. 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that the area of the Purchased Unit, as shown in the Purchased Unit Floor Plan is an approximation only and acknowledges that the actual floor area may vary from the area as stated . 
 
 DEFAULT BY THE DEVELOPER 
 
 Subject to the terms of the Agreement, in the event that t he Developer is unable to deliver possession of the Purchased Unit within six (6) month s following the Estimated Completion Date, then, provided the Buyer has fulfilled all obligations and has made complete Instalment P ayment s in the Payment Plan , including the amount payable on possession and any applicable Adjusted Amount , the Developer shall pay the Buyer a monthly fee until such time as the Purchased Unit is ready for delivery of possession to the Buyer. The monthly fee shall be calculated on a pro-rata basis and shall be equal to five percent ( 5 %) per annum of the total payments received from the Buyer to date . 
 
 DEFAULT BY THE BUYER AND DEFAULTING PENALTY 
 
 If the Buyer fails to pay any Instalment Payment or other payments due under the Agreement to t he Developer , the Management Company or to any Competent Authority , within ten ( 10 ) days of its Due Date, then t he Developer may : 
 
 impose liquidated damages at the rate of two percent ( 2 %) per month on each outstanding In stal ment Payment or any part thereof and /or any other payment ( s ) that remain (s) outstanding from the date such payment became due , to be paid in addition to such outstanding payments ; and /or 
 
 in the event the default is not cured within sixty (60) days of the relevant Due Date, upon serving of first written notice of seven ( 7 ) days followed by final written notice of seven ( 7) days to the Buyer, terminate the Agreement forthwith and recover liquidated damages from the Buyer equivalent to fifteen percent (15%) of the Purchase Price, in addition to the damages imposed under Clause 12.1(i) above. After deducting all charges under this Clause 12.1 and any other charges that may be applicable from the Instalments Payments paid by the Buyer in accordance with the Payment Plan, the Developer shall refund the balance amount, if any, to the Buyer. In the event of any shortfall, the Developer shall be entitled to its rights under law to recover the same from the Buyer. 
 
 In the event that the Buyer fails to give any undertaking or execute any document or take possession of the Purchased Unit, then t he Developer may take the action specified under Clause 12.1 above. 
 
 Delay in pa yment of any two or more Instal ment Payments or delay exceeding sixty (60) days in payment of any applicable Adjusted Amount shall be treated as a default by the Buyer and t he Developer will be entitled to take action in accordance with Clause 12.1 above. 
 
 Joint Buyers shall, jointly and individually , be responsible to fulfil l and discharge all the obligations hereinabove mentioned. Upon breach of any of the conditions of the Agreement by any one or all of them, t he Developer shall be at liberty for recourse and redressal in the terms of the Agreement against any one or all of the j oint Buyers (as t he Developer may determine in its sole discretion). 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 “Event of Force Majeure” means an act of God including but not limited to fire, flood, earthquake, windstorm or other natural disaster; act of any sovereign authority including but not limited to war, invasion, act of foreign enemies, hostilities (whether war be declared or not), civil war, rebellion, revolution, insurrection, military or usurped power or confiscation, nationalization, requisition, act of terrorism or destruction or damage to property by or under the order of any government or public or local authority or other Competent Authority or imposition of government sanction embargo or similar action; labour dispute including but not limited to strike, lockout or boycott; interruption or failure of utility service including but not limited to electric power, water or telephone service; failure of the transportation of any personnel, equipment, machinery or material required by t he Developer for completion of the Project; breach of contract by any essential contractor or subcontractor or any other matter or cause beyond the control of t he Developer that prevents it from completing or performing its obligations under the Agreement. The Developer shall not be liable for such non-completion or non-performance under the Agreement for so long as such Event of Force Majeure exists and its effects continue. 
 
 Should an Event of Force Majeure occur that is likely to or will delay the Estimate Completion Date or Completion Date, the Developer shall promptly notify the Buyer in writing of the event and give the Buyer a revised Estimated Completion or Completion Date or an estimate of the duration of the delay , as and when it can be determined. Extensions in the Estimated Completion or Completion Date on account of an Event of Force Majeure shall be in addition to any other extensions pursuant to the terms hereof . 
 
 No Event of Force Majeure which is less than thirty (30) calendar days shall excuse the Buyer from making any Instalment Payment on its Due Date, which may be extended for a period equal to the duration of the Event of Force Majeure. Provided that any Event of Force Majeure exceeding thirty (30) days shall result in a commensurate adjustment of the Due Date of any remaining Instalment Payments or any applicable Adjusted Amount . 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 The Agreement , as defined in Clause 2 of the Agreement to Sell, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties and there are no other representations, warranties, conditions or collateral agreements, express or implied, written or oral, whether made by t he Developer , any officer, agent, employee or representative of t he Developer or any other person including, without limitation, arising out of any marketing material including sales brochures, models, representative view sets, show room displays, photographs, videos, illustrations, renderings, revenue projections or pro-forma statements provided to the Buyer or made available for his/her viewing and , upon acceptance by t he Developer , the Agreement shall form a binding agreement subject only to the terms and conditions contained t herein. 
 
 Except as contemplated in the Agreement , any modification or amendment to the Agreement shall be in writing duly signed by both Parties . 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges that s he /he will be bound by the Management Agreement and any building rules, regulations and policies that may be applicable from time to time . 
 
 GOVERNING LAW AND ARBITRATION 
 
 The Agreement and the rights and obligations of the Parties under or pursuant to the Agreement shall be governed and construed according to the laws of Pakistan, with the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Lahore. 
 
 Any dispute between the Parties arising out of or with respect to the Agreement will be resolved amicably between the Parties within fifteen (15) days of its so arising, failing which it shall be referred to and settled by arbitration under the Arbitration Act (X of 1940). After lapse of fifteen (15) days, arbitration proceedings may be initiated by delivery of a notice in writing by either Party to the other Party. The arbitration panel shall consist of three arbitrators: one each to be appointed by each Party and a third to be appointed mutually by the first two arbitrators. The place of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language of the arbitration proceedings shall be English. The decision and award of the arbitrator(s), as the case may be, shall be final, non-appealable and binding on both Parties, including decisions as to costs. 
 
 NOTICES 
 
 Without prejudice to the right to serve notice by any other means, any notice required to be served under the Agreement shall be in writing in the English language and shall be deemed sufficiently served forty-eight (48) hours after it has been mailed by registered post or twenty-four (24) hours if served through e-mail , to the address of the Developer Party to be served that is set out in the Agreement to Sell or to such other address of which a notice has been previously given by the Party. 
 
 It is clarified that in the case there is more than one Buyer, notice to any one Buyer shall be deemed as notice to all Buyers and t he Developer shall be under no obligation to write to each Buyer individually. 
 
 Buyer shall notify the Developer in writing, in advance, of any change of address (postal, email, or otherwise). Buyer’s failure to report a change of address shall not affect validity of service of any notice that may be served by the Developer to the Buyer at the last known address . 
 
 SURVIVAL 
 
 The Buyer acknowledges and agrees that the Agreement will survive the Completion Date and transfer of the Purchased Unit in the name of the Buyer and any subsequent buyer . The Agreement shall en ure to the benefit of and be binding upon the Parties hereto and their respective personal representatives, heirs, successors, and permitted assignees. 
 
 The Developer agrees that in case of the death of the Buyer , t he Developer shall make reasonable efforts to assist the Nominee named by the Buyer to procure the succession of the legal heirs to the rights of the Buyer under the Agreement , in accordance with the requirements of applicable law s of inheritance . Provided that the Nominee shall cause all such legal heirs to execute a letter of adherence (or such other document which confirms the legal heirs taking over and being fully bound by the obligations of the Buyer unde r the Agreement) and indemnify t he Developer for any loss or damage on account of claims by the other legal heirs of the Buyer . 
 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 
 The Agreement may be executed, accepted and delivered in two counterparts, both of which shall together constitute one and the same Agreement. 
 
 TIME IS OF ESSENCE 
 
 Notwithstanding anything contained in the Agreement, the time fixed for payment or any part thereof under this Agreement is and shall be the essence of the Agreement. 
 
 WAIVER 
 
 The delay or failure of either Party to enforce or insist upon strict compliance with any of the terms or conditions of the Agreement shall not constitute a waiver of said Party’s rights hereunder. 
 
 SEVERABILITY 
 
 If any one or more provisions of the Agreement or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall, within thirty (30) days of such declaration or judgment, substitute the affected provisions in such a way that, to the maximum extent possible, the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question . 
 
 TERMINATION AND CANCELLATION OF SALE 
 
 Subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, the Buyer may cancel or terminate the Agreement at any time, subject to deduction of cancellation charges equal to fifteen percent (1 5 %) of the Purchase Price and deduction on account of any other change or cost payable by the Buyer under the Agreement . The balance of any payment made by the Buyer under the Agreement, if any, will be refunded to the Buyer within six (6) months of termination or upon re-sale of the cancelled Purchased Unit, whichever comes later. 
 
 Any refund upon termination under Clause 22.1 shall be subject to deduction of the difference between the Purchase Price and the market price of the Purchased Unit at the time of termination, in the event that the latter is lower. 
 
 In case of termination under Clause 22 .1 , the Buyer shall surrender all original documents, acknowledgements of receipt and any other correspondence under the Agreement, including without limitation the Agreement itself. 
 
 Subject to the terms and conditions of the Agreement, the Developer may cancel or terminate the Agreement in the event of breach of the Agreement by the Buyer as envisaged herein. Any refund to the Buyer as a result of termination under this Clause 22.4 shall be subject to deduction of cancellation charges equal to fifteen percent (15%) of the Purchase Price and deduction on account of any other charge or cost payable by the Buyer under the Agreement. 
 
 GOOD FAITH 
 
 Each Party shall in good faith perf orm their obligations under the Agreement based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 
 ACKNOWLEDGEMENT 
 
 The Buyer hereby confirms having read , understood and accepted the Agreement in its entirety, and is affixing his/her signature in the presence of witnesses.
